Don’t miss conversations in Web Design, Email Design - Email Marketing & UX/UI

.....................................Web Design, Email Design - Email Marketing & UX/UI
This is a vibrant community for professionals, enthusiasts, and learners in the fields of web design, email design, email marketing, and UX/UI. Whether you're a seasoned expert or just starting out, our group offers a platform to connect, share knowledge, and stay updated on the latest trends and best practices.

What We Offer:
- Industry Insights: Stay informed about the latest developments, tools, and techniques in web and email design, email marketing strategies, and UX/UI best practices.
- Resource Sharing: Access and share valuable resources including articles, tutorials, case studies, and more to enhance your skills and knowledge.
- Q&A and Discussions: Engage in meaningful discussions, ask questions, and get advice from experienced members of the community.
- Showcase Your Work: Share your projects, get feedback, and find inspiration from the creative work of others.

In addition, we recommend some fantastic tools to streamline your work and boost your productivity:
https://designmodo.com/postcards/ - An intuitive email builder that helps you create beautiful, responsive emails effortlessly.
https://siter.io/ - A no-code website builder that allows you to design and publish websites quickly and easily.
https://pulsetic.com/ - A reliable service for website uptime monitoring and alerts, ensuring your site remains online and accessible.
https://unspam.email/ - An email spam checker that helps you optimize your emails to avoid spam filters and improve deliverability.

Let's innovate and elevate the standards of web design, email marketing, and user experience together!

Who Should Join:
- Web Designers
- Email Designers
- Email Marketers
- UX/UI Designers
- Digital Marketing Professionals

Let's collaborate, create, and lead the future of digital design and marketing!

subject: Don’t miss conversations in User experience (UX) design, Product Design, Conversation Design | UXThisWeek
body_text:
Don’t miss conversations in User experience (UX) design, Product Design, Conversation Design | UXThisWeek 

.....................................User experience (UX) design, Product Design, Conversation Design | UXThisWeek 
This group is to learn, reflect and share about User Experience. New trends in experience design for AI, Machine Learning, Voice, Conversations to IOT. You are welcome to discuss the design process. You are requested to learn, reflect and share to help, coach ,or to become mentor to the members who need it.
To get updates on UX industry news and curated articles and resources subscript our Newsletter

https://mailchi.mp/e19527579657/uxdesignthinking

*****************************
💢 Who are we?
We are a strong community of more than 22000 + members from across the world. We are learners and practitioners of UX Design, UX Strategy, Design Thinking , Product management and everything around it. We create emerging experiences for the products and services for the users or trying to learn how to create one. 

💎 What we do?
We share our own experience with the group, meet new aspiring UX Designers, Junior Product Managers, People from other fields want to move to UX and learn it. We try to help them by answering their questions, help them clear their fear, encourage them to take on the opportunity and help them by guiding, coaching and supporting them way possible . 

💎 Aspiring UX Designer? want to learn UX process?
We also develop free courses for our aspiring UX Designers and Product Managers to start with on various topics on UX, Design Thinking and Product Management. So If you want to be one of us to develop courses with all of us as a Volunteer, Course curator, Copy Writer, Workshop facilitator, Product Manager, Project Manager, Design Sprint Organiser, Design Thinker or you name it , you are welcome to join the party. Please do write me at thegoutamdey@gmail.com or DM me at @thegoutamdey .

body_text:
Jasmin, this is what you've missed on LinkedIn

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Suddenly, everyone seems to be talking about “quiet quitting” — so, what is it? In a nutshell, "quiet quitting" is when a worker meets their minimum job requirements....and that's it. This can can mean radio silence after 5PM, avoiding non-mandatory meetings and events or turning down projects: https://lnkd.in/eKWyuF47 Is quiet quitting really a new trend, born out of burnout, or is it just a new name for the very old experience of gradually giving up on a job? What causes it? And what's the right response? Take our poll and leave your thoughts in the comments. ✍🏻: Max Lockie

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: The School of Film/Video at #CalArts has been ranked fifth in The Hollywood Reporter’s 2022 ranking of the 25 Best American #Film Schools, citing its approaches to both ‘traditional and experimental mediamaking’ and the ‘unique equipment’ available to students. Read more at 24700. https://lnkd.in/gG8GkRHi

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: ‘Baldwin was not a single story; there were many Baldwins.’ #CalArts School of Critical Studies faculty and performance artist Gabrielle Civil was quoted in the Miami Herald’s recent article about the 2022 International Conference on James Baldwin held in Nice, France. Read more at the Miami Herald. https://lnkd.in/g6sTuYXv #CriticalStudies

-----------------------------------------


California Institute of the Arts shared a post: CalArts student Erika Salazar Gutierrez is among the 11 students and young professionals announced as a 2022 Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences Foundation Scholar. Gutierrez was awarded a WomenIn Scholarship (one of the three scholarships awarded by AIAS), which seeks to "attract, retain and advance women in the interactive entertainment industry by supporting their education and professional development." https://lnkd.in/ghBBiEw5

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Your job skills are like seeing The Matrix 🕶 LinkedIn editor-in-chief Daniel Roth discusses how to translate everyday skills into buzzwords for your resume on the TODAY Show. Here's more on why skills-based hiring is on the rise: https://lnkd.in/gQk24dz8

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: There are tens of thousands of U.S. government allies who remain in Iraq and Afghanistan– their lives endangered because of their association and support of Americans during the war. But evacuating and resettling them hasn’t been easy. Nina Melendez Ibarra Melendez sits down with Jeff Phaneuf and Ali Seena (He/Him/His) of No One Left Behind to discuss the efforts behind getting former interpreters and government workers to safety. Click the “Attend” button to get a notification when the show begins. Have questions for our guests? Let us know in the comments below and get them answered when we go LIVE. #LinkedInNewsLive

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: Employees are shifting their priorities in the workplace. New studies suggest that there is less focus on climbing corporate ladders. Find out more below. #TrendingNow Read more: https://lnkd.in/ertNjsNr

-----------------------------------------


LinkedIn News shared a post: You may have heard the acronym OKR thrown around at work. The initials stand for objectives and key results, which is a way to set goals with clear outcomes. Jessie Withers, M.A.'s LinkedIn Learning lesson on OKRs is the most popular course of the year! She will join LinkedIn News editor Andrew Seaman to discuss the ins and outs of goal setting on Friday, August 12, for #GetHired Live. They’ll also answer your questions!
